boundary: Original 2026-11-14 paid retrieval records, replayed offline. A is historical exact serialized Prompt evidence. B/C/D only omit entries. No new model input or score output is measured here.

selection.A: Historical full eligible Prompt evidence, threshold disabled
selection.D: Existing inclusive 0.70F cutoff, no additional cap. Declared by the original protocol before result; no calibration or search.

metricNotes.precisionMicro: First occurrence of each DIRECT chunk per query divided by actual returned entries; later duplicates remain in denominator. Includes negatives for all.
metricNotes.precisionMacroNonEmpty: Mean of per-query values over non-empty queries only. Empty precision is undefined.
metricNotes.hitCountsByOriginalRank: Any DIRECT at original rank ≤ k; absence is a miss, irrespective of display position.
metricNotes.pAt5FixedDenominator: DIRECT count divided by 5 × queries; empty ranks count zero. Positive candidate evaluation uses only frozen positive queries.
metricNotes.positiveEmptyRate: No selected evidence, whether inherently lacking corpus support or not. Known corpus DIRECT empty count and no-DIRECT misses reported separately.
metricNotes.productionLabelLimit: Point labels identify DIRECT and CONTRIBUTION_ONLY. Unmapped chunks are UNASSESSED, not reclassified as RELATED_ONLY, IRRELEVANT, or harmless.
metricNotes.coverage: Production uses assigned score point IDs, follow-up uses only the target CORE. Public regular queries use an implicit intent, cross-topic uses frozen fullAnswerRequires. Independent uses adjudicated intent IDs. Only distinct directly supported IDs count.
metricNotes.length: Exact UTF-16 from the archived Prompt string, including metadata and empty marker for section length. No provider token count for this section. Alternative lengths are reconstructed by omission.
metricNotes.latency: Historical embedding, search, hydration and formatting wall time. Replay has no live comparative latency.
metricNotes.recall: No certified human-labeled complete relevance set. No exact recall claimed.
metricNotes.duplicate: The frozen data has no repeats. This replay does not simulate introducing a deduplication rule.

labelDisagreements.production: Prior point evidence review, no pairwise disagreement estimate
labelDisagreements.status: AI provisional. Original assessor decisions remain stored with their labels. Independent set is now a diagnostic regression set.
